meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via the selected gateway. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给智能体换上能自主规划、调度工具并续接会话的新推理后端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给 Agent 换一个推理后端,同时保留会话历史与工具能力。
copy.tagline_en: Swap your agent onto a backend that plans, calls tools, and resumes sessions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to run on a different provider while keeping history and tools.

howto.what: 安装后,NanoClaw 的群组可用 Codex 作为 agent 后端:由它做规划、工具编排和 MCP 工具调用,对话历史存在服务端并以线程 id 续接。凭据只放 OneCLI 保险库,不写进 .env。
howto.when: 当你要把某个群组的 agent 后端换成 Codex(或给新群组用 Codex)时接管:在主机上运行 ncl groups config update --provider codex,再重启该群组。原文未写自动触发词。

say.text: 把这个群组的 provider 换成 codex,然后重启它。
say.note: 切换需在主机上运行 ncl 命令

say.text: 把新群组的默认 agent provider 设为 codex。
say.note: 只影响之后创建的群组

say.text: 跑一下 codex 的凭据认证,用 ChatGPT 订阅登录。
say.note: 凭据落到 OneCLI 保险库

howto.what_en: Installs Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider for NanoClaw: planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history and session resume. Credentials stay vault-only in OneCLI; no key in .env.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you switch a group's agent backend to Codex, run from the host: `ncl groups config update --provider codex`, then restart the group. No automatic trigger words are defined.

say_en.text: Switch this group's provider to codex and restart it.
say_en.note: The ncl commands run on the host

say_en.text: Set the default agent provider for new groups to codex.
say_en.note: Applies only to groups created afterwards

say_en.text: Run the codex provider auth and log in with my ChatGPT subscription.
say_en.note: Lands the secret in the OneCLI vault
